Every screen and state of the sidebar, 39 in all, in both themes. They are screenshots of the real sidebar at the width Docs and Slides give it, 300 px. Regenerate them with node scripts/sidebar-states.mjs.

Unlock

Shown until the licence check passes. A one-time $5 purchase unlocks Docs and Slides.

Scanning

What the list shows before it has images.

Image list

One card per image. The tick on the thumbnail decides what downloads, converts, renames and optimizes.

Selection

The bar above the list. Its buttons act on the images currently listed.

Bulk rename

One pattern for every ticked image, with a live preview. Renames the list, not the file.

Output settings

Convert, crop and bundle. Closing this section turns conversion off.

Optimize images

Replaces the file’s own pictures with smaller copies, after a confirmation.

Menu

The three dots at the top right.

In Google Slides

The same sidebar. The wording says deck, and the Markdown option is hidden.
